segments.name: Insurance
products: excess-of-loss, quota-share and facultative reinsurance contracts
segments.description: Underwrites private passenger automobile, commercial property and casualty, and life and health risks, plus reinsurance, worldwide through GEICO, BH Primary and BHRG.
segments.evidence: Berkshire's insurance subsidiaries provide insurance and reinsurance of property and casualty risks as well as life and health risks worldwide.

segments.name: Burlington Northern Santa Fe
segments.description: Operates a large freight rail transportation system in North America, hauling freight for shippers across the continent.
segments.evidence: Through BNSF Railway, BNSF operates over 32,500 route miles of track (excluding multiple main tracks, yard tracks and sidings) in 28 states.

segments.name: Berkshire Hathaway Energy
segments.description: Operates regulated electric and gas utilities, natural gas pipelines, power generation and distribution businesses, and real estate brokerage activities.
segments.evidence: Berkshire Hathaway Energy ("BHE") Operator of regulated electric and gas utilities, natural gas pipelines and other power generation and distribution businesses, and real estate brokerage activities

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes industrial, consumer and building products, and builds homes with related financial services for customers.
segments.evidence: Berkshire's numerous and diverse manufacturing subsidiaries are grouped into three categories: (1) industrial products, (2) building products and (3) consumer products.

segments.name: Service and retailing
segments.description: Provides aviation services, electronic components distribution, trailer and furniture leasing, and retailing including automobile dealerships and home furnishings stores.
segments.evidence: Berkshire's service businesses provide shared aircraft ownership programs and professional aviation training programs ("aviation services"), and distribution of electronic components.

segments.name: McLane Company
segments.description: Distributes food and non-food items wholesale to convenience stores, discount retailers, restaurants and other retail customers.
segments.evidence: McLane Company, Inc. ("McLane") provides wholesale distribution services in all 50 states to customers that include convenience stores, discount retailers, wholesale clubs, drug stores, military bases, quick service restaurants and casual dining restaurants.

segments.name: Pilot Travel Centers
products: wholesale fuel and fuel marketing businesses
segments.description: Operates retail travel centers in North America and markets fuel wholesale to customers and third parties.
segments.evidence: Pilot Travel Centers ("Pilot") (1) Operator of retail travel centers in North America and a marketer of fuel on a wholesale basis
